861:t_070:11.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Games are meant to be enjoyed, after all.」

861:t_071:3.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「Tell me, $$五飛$$. How many more stages must we clear?」

861:t_071:5.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「How many more times must we continue...? $$ゼロ#wing_zero$$ won't tell me anything... Tell me, $$五飛$$.」

861:t_071:6.en:
$$五飛$$
「Is that... going to happen all over again?」

861:t_072:3.en:
$$カトル$$
「You're stopping the game here, then. That's a wise decision, just like you.」

861:t_072:4.en:
$$カトル$$
「Please don't let the exhaustion of battle make you lose sight of your own heart.」

861:t_072:5.en:
$$カトル$$
「I will never allow that to happen...」

861:t_072:6.en:
$$カトル$$
「Get plenty of rest and become your usual self again. See you next time!」

861:t_073:3.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「Why are you suspending the operation? If you don't come back right now, I'll ki...」

861:t_073:4.en:
$$デュオ$$
「Cut it out, $$ヒイロ$$. Don't compare the player to someone with your superhuman stamina.」

861:t_073:5.en:
$$トロワ$$
「If you don't do everything in moderation, you'll end up like these two.」

861:t_073:6.en:
$$カトル$$
「You're getting in my way. Then... you'll die!」

861:t_073:7.en:
$$五飛$$
「If a greater evil appears, the player will return! Then I will become that evil!」

861:t_073:8.en:
$$デュオ$$
「...So that's why you shouldn't overdo it with games!」

861:t_074:3.en:
$$ロラン$$
「Players, Super Robot Wars is a game that really makes you want to know what happens next!」

861:t_074:5.en:
$$ロラン$$
「Super Robot Wars is a game that really makes you want to know what happens next!」

861:t_075:3.en:
$$ロラン$$
「People from another planet attacked from far across space and invaded Earth.」

861:t_075:4.en:
$$ロラン$$
「To stop a great war that twists people's hearts, I decide to pilot a mobile suit again.」

861:t_075:5.en:
$$ロラン$$
「I hope we can somehow take Earth back...」

861:t_075:6.en:
$$ロラン$$
「Next time, 'The Stolen Earth.' A wind shook the dimensions...」

861:t_076:3.en:
$$ロラン$$
「From the words of someone calling themselves an emissary of God, I learned that humanity was about to be destroyed.」

861:t_076:4.en:
$$ロラン$$
「The wishes of so many people who long for peace gather together and become a great power.」

861:t_076:5.en:
$$ロラン$$
「And we made up our minds...!」

861:t_076:6.en:
$$ロラン$$
「Next time, 'The Golden Galaxy.' The wind crosses dimensions...」

861:t_077:3.en:
$$ガロード$$
「$$ティファ$$! Hey, $$ティファ$$! Come over here and say a few words before we go!」

861:t_077:5.en:
$$ティファ$$
「...Please... Promise me. Promise you'll come back so we can end this war soon...」

861:t_077:6.en:
$$ガロード$$
「You're lucky to get a message from $$ティファ$$! I guarantee you've got good luck!」

861:t_077:7.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Luck is always there! See ya!」

861:t_078:3.en:
$$ガロード$$
「I've quit the game... There. Now... I'll go see $$ティファ$$.」

861:t_078:4.en:
$$アルベルト$$
「Don't get carried away, $$ガロード・ラン$$. If you think everything will go your way, you're sorely mistaken.」

861:t_078:5.en:
$$ガロード$$
「I know that without you telling me. Even so, I'll live my life with $$ティファ$$.」

861:t_078:6.en:
$$ガロード$$
「You should be more honest, too. Life's more fun when you're true to your feelings.」

861:t_078:8.en:
$$ガロード$$
「See you, players. We only get one life, so let's live without regrets.」

861:t_079:3.en:
$$シン$$
「You're stopping here? Then I might take a break, too.」

861:t_079:4.en:
$$シン$$
「I'll fight when I should, but I have to rest when I can... Make sure you come back, though.」

861:t_079:5.en:
$$シン$$
「You and all of us will fight together. That's the only way we can achieve peace.」

861:t_080:3.en:
$$ルナマリア$$
「That's all for this mission.」

861:t_080:4.en:
$$シン$$
「You players should get plenty of rest, too.」

861:t_080:5.en:
$$ルナマリア$$
「Huh? You're not going to say, 'What are you thinking!?' or anything...?」

861:t_080:7.en:
$$ルナマリア$$
「You used to say things like, 'Stopping the game here... I...!'」

861:t_080:8.en:
$$シン$$
「D-don't bring up the past! Come on... Let's say goodbye to all the players together.」

861:t_080:9.en:
$$ルナマリア$$
「Yes, yes. Well then, everyone...」

861:t_080:10.en:
$$シン$$
「Thanks for all your hard work!」

861:t_081:3.en:
$$アスラン$$
「$$キラ$$... How long are we going to keep fighting...?」

861:t_081:4.en:
$$キラ$$
「$$アスラン$$... That's up to us and all the players.」

861:t_081:6.en:
$$キラ$$
「'3rd Super Robot Wars Z Tengoku-hen'... Let's fight to bring it all to an end.」

861:t_081:7.en:
$$キラ$$
「This is the final battle of the long-running 'Z' series... Players, please lend us your resolve and strength, too.」

861:t_081:8.en:
$$アスラン$$
「I'll be waiting for you all to return. Fight alongside us again.」

861:t_082:4.en:
$$刹那$$
「The fighting goes on. But I'm sure peace lies beyond it.」

861:t_082:5.en:
$$刹那$$
「I believe peace will be waiting when you clear '3rd Super Robot Wars Z.'」

861:t_082:6.en:
$$刹那$$
「That's why I'll fight alongside you. Until we meet again.」

861:t_083:3.en:
$$グラハム$$
「I never knew discarding my mask... could feel so good.」

861:t_083:4.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「You're right. You cast away your past and your false self, and your whole heart is set free.」

861:t_083:5.en:
$$シャア$$
「And that is precisely why new trials will await you.」

861:t_083:6.en:
$$グラハム$$
「But you must not fear them.」

861:t_083:7.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「You players should cast aside the masks over your hearts and live honestly, too.」

861:t_083:8.en:
$$シャア$$
「And let us meet again, in this '3rd Super Robot Wars Z.'」

861:t_084:3.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「The 'Super Robot Wars Z' series is finally coming to an end...」

861:t_084:4.en:
$$シン$$
「You and I have known each other a long time, too.」

861:t_084:5.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「We have. When we first met, I wondered how things would turn out...」

861:t_084:6.en:
$$シン$$
「I told you to stop bringing up the past!」

861:t_084:7.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「But I'm glad I got to fight alongside you and all the players.」

861:t_084:8.en:
$$シン$$
「It's too early to say things like that. The fighting isn't over yet.」

861:t_084:9.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「You're right. You, me, and all the players... Let's fight to the end together.」

861:t_085:3.en:
$$くらら$$
「I'll cast Strike, Valor, Alert, Fortune, and Gain...」

861:t_085:4.en:
$$朔哉$$
「I wondered where you were, and here you are playing games...!」

861:t_085:5.en:
$$葵$$
「Oh, let me see...? 'Super Robot Wars Z'?」

861:t_085:6.en:
$$ジョニー$$
「Then let me give you a useful tip!」
